newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony 97/98 operating profit seen up 16 pct-analyst.
newsitem.headline: Sony 97/98 operating profit seen up 16 pct-analyst.

text.p: Sony Corp's group operating profit is expected to climb 16 percent in the current business year to next March 31, following an estimated 50 percent rise last year, Morgan Stanley Japan said on Wednesday.

Analyst Takatoshi Yamamoto said Sony's profits would hit record highs for the second consecutive year as the company continued to benefit from the weak yen, favourable sales of its PlayStation videogame players and the launch of new digital audiovisual products during the year.
Yamamoto estimates Sony's group operating profit for fiscal 1997/98 at 409.1 billion yen, up from an estimated 353.5 billion yen profit for 1996/97.
He expects group net profit of 157.8 billion yen for the 1997/98 year, up from an estimated 137.5 billion yen in 1996/97.
Upward revisions of the 1997/98 profit estimates are likely if the yen's weakening continues, he said.
